topic: Does the official Notion MCP (@notionhq/notion-mcp-server, ~18 tools) cover a full mcp-notion mode of the mcp-tooling hub at mcp-obsidian parity, or is custom CLI/MCP tooling plus a Notion knowledge layer required? Adopt-vs-build verdict, plus the Notion knowledge layer (databases, properties, relations, rollups, formulas, API version) the mode must encode.

focus: Official Notion MCP Server — complete tool inventory & capability map
noveltyJustification: First pass; all findings are new — tool count correction (18→24), data sources migration, markdown round-trip, deprecation status

focus: Full Notion REST API surface beyond MCP tools — gap analysis, rate limits, property types
noveltyJustification: Expanded gap list to endpoint level; added rate limits (3 r/s) and 22 property types as foundational knowledge

focus: mcp-obsidian capability set — full parity baseline (3 surfaces, 15 ops, 11 plugins)
noveltyJustification: First systematic enumeration of mcp-obsidian's 3-surface architecture, 15-operation table, and 11-plugin knowledge layer as parity baseline

focus: Parity mapping mcp-obsidian → Notion MCP, gap classification (structural vs tooling)
noveltyJustification: First systematic parity mapping with structural vs tooling gap classification; capability-by-capability analysis is net-new

ruledOut.reason: Notion's archive model is the native pattern; pursuing hard delete fights the platform
Architecturally impossible for a cloud service

focus: Adopt vs build analysis — three-pattern comparison, verdict: BUILD (light workflow)
noveltyJustification: First three-pattern taxonomy analysis; deprecation-risk-as-build-argument is a new lens; verdict is net-new synthesis

ruledOut.reason: Architecturally wrong for a workspace-mutating mode; cannot make direct API calls for 5 tooling gaps
Over-engineered for a plugin-less platform; 6 of 11 plugin domains are structurally non-applicable

focus: Notion knowledge layer — databases, data sources, 22 property types with schema configurations
noveltyJustification: Full schema configs, page property value formats, filter/sort model, and database→data source→page hierarchy are net-new detail beyond iteration 2's high-level enumeration

focus: Advanced knowledge layer — relations (single/dual), rollups (14 functions), formula language (Formulas 2.0)
noveltyJustification: Formula function catalog, rollup non-computed aggregations, dual_property back-reference mechanism, Dataview parity analysis are net-new

focus: Auth + runtime — three token types, remote MCP OAuth, rate limits, headless/Code Mode constraints, dual-backend routing
noveltyJustification: Three-token-type model, remote MCP OAuth requirement, token incompatibility, dual-backend routing doctrine, Code Mode integration model, error handling doctrine are net-new

ruledOut.reason: Requires interactive OAuth, incompatible with headless/Code Mode; mode must support local stdio server despite deprecation

noveltyJustification: Per-tool version mapping, version pinning doctrine, 015 migration tie-in analysis, async task tool discovery are net-new

focus: Final gap analysis + verdict consolidation — 10 iterations complete, 6/6 questions resolved
noveltyJustification: Final gap matrix, complete mode architecture, mode-registry entry proposal, smart routing logic are net-new synthesis artifacts
